title: Finacée
text: ……Huh? Melty=Melromarc? That doesn’t sound right. Did I hear wrong? That name is definitely… my Finacée’s name.
“Um…”
My Father leans over and whispers in my ear.
“Not the ‘Bitch’—I’m talking about Motoyasu-kun. The princess who ran away with me during the kidnapping incident is here, right? Wasn’t she supposed to come after the next wave?”
“That’s weird, isn’t it?”
“By the way, what’s she like again? I mean, I know she was really close with that girl, Filo.”

“She’s a girl with distinctive blue hair. Her height and build are almost exactly the same as Filo-tan’s. Her face isn’t quite as pretty as Filo-tan’s, but she’s still among the top few. And when it comes to Filolial, she’s my equal… She’s truly my Rival, and she’s Filo-tan’s Finacée.”
“W-well, I don’t really get it, but is she a pervert on par with Motoyasu-kun?”
“I get where you’re coming from, bro, but you’re saying way too much.”
“Oh, sorry… Well, let’s at least try talking to her. She’s someone we can trust when it comes to the future, after all.”
While my Father and I were having a private conversation, things outside the carriage started to get a little noisy.
“Filolial?”
“Huh?”
When I looked, sure enough, my Finacée was there, reaching out toward Sakura-chan’s face.
“H-Her Highness!”
Even though the knights were warning her, she just ignored them and kept gazing into Sakura-chan’s eyes. Sakura-chan, having been touched, narrowed her eyes as if it felt good.
“So it really is Filolial-sama pulling the Holy One of the Divine Bird’s carriage. A Filolial like this… it’s amazing. I’ve never seen anything like it before.”
“Hmm?”
“D-do you talk?”
My finacée is looking at Sakura-chan with a surprised expression. Apparently, at this point, she doesn’t know that Filolial-sama can speak.
“Yeah, Sakura can talk, you know?”
“Wow… It’s always been my dream to talk to a Filolial! Tell me more… about yourself.”
My finacée is chatting with Sakura-chan with great enthusiasm. Perhaps feeling good about the genuine affection she’s receiving, Sakura-chan answered honestly.
“Well, my name is Sakura. My job is to protect Naofumi, and right now I’m pulling the carriage.”
“Is that so? I came here to have an important talk with your master. I’d like to build a good relationship from now on.”
“Hmm…”
“Hey, hey, can I pet you some more?”
“Sure. But Luna-chan’s chest feathers are fluffier than Sakura’s, you know?”
“Let me pet you anyway.”
“Sure.”

Father is watching the scene with a warm smile. Just as I expected from my Finacée. She’s already deepening her friendship with Filolial-sama. Even though the world has changed, she’s a worthy Rival. I absolutely won’t lose!
“She doesn’t seem like a bad kid at first glance, and according to Motoyasu-kun, there shouldn’t be any problems.”
My father steps down from the carriage and walks over to my Finacée.
“I wonder if he takes a liking to her?”
“Eh… ah, yes.”
When my father addressed her, my finacée bowed with a slightly nervous expression.
“It’s a pleasure to meet you, Holy One of the Divine Bird. My name is Melty Melromarc. Please forgive me for visiting you in such a place.”
Huh? The finacée I know used to speak to my father with much more assertiveness. Well, first impressions are important, after all. I’m sure she’s just hiding her true, feisty nature.

But it’s also true that her true nature is the one that really shines. It’s far better than flaunting her noble birth and acting all polite yet condescending. As expected of my Finacée—it was her intention to make a good first impression, and it was that very skill that allowed her to secure her engagement to Filo-tan from my Father.

Filo-tan also doted on her Finacée. I know this fellow is by no means a bad person. Trying to make a good impression on others is a sign of respect for them. I, who once showed respect even to pigs, can say this with certainty. Under no circumstances is it a means to look down on others, like the Crimson Swine over there.
“Well then, since the princess has introduced herself, the Saint of the Divine Bird should also reveal his true face and introduce himself!”
The Finacée glares at her accompanying knight with a look of displeasure.
“That would offend the Saint of the Divine Bird. Watch your language.”
“H-ha!”
He salutes, acting as if he’s accepted his Finacée’s reprimand, but something about him seems suspicious. Her Father was quietly observing the scene.
“He places such great importance on etiquette… I suppose I must reciprocate.”

My future Father pulled back the hood of his robe to reveal his face. In other words, he has opened up to my Finacée to a certain extent. However, that seems to apply only to her; he remains wary of the knights. Well, given how high-handed these fellows are acting, that’s only to be expected.
“Well, I am the one known in this country as the Saint of the Divine Bird. As for my name, I am not yet in a position to reveal it, so I ask for your understanding.”
“……I can understand the circumstances preventing you from revealing your name. Please forgive the rudeness of my sister and my Father.”

It seems my Finacée, as if she understands the circumstances as well, is proceeding with the conversation without deliberately revealing the true identity of my future Father. She truly is a worthy Finacée.

Her administrative skills in villages and towns are so capable they bring to mind that queen, and she possesses the dignity befitting a king who will one day ascend the throne of Melromarc—a nation destined to become the largest in the world. When I think about it that way, it’s only natural that I—a mere… “Legendary Hero,” as I’m known—can’t earn my future Father’s trust when it comes to Filo-tan. But I absolutely won’t lose!
“So, what brings you here to talk with us this time?”
“Well… first of all, I’ve come to meet you, Your Holiness, on behalf of the nation to make a request.”
“A request?”
“Yes.”

I wonder what it could be? I haven’t heard the full details of what happened when my future Father ran off with my Finacée. All I’ve heard is that my Finacée went to meet him and was kidnapped right then and there.
After that, I chased after my Father the whole time, and I remember how hard it was to catch him. Well, it took me a while to realize I’d been deceived, though.
“Please, Your Holiness, I’d like you to reconcile with my Father.”
My Father looks utterly dumbfounded. I’m dumbfounded too. My Finacée, that’s an impossible request.

Unless the heavens and earth turn upside down, there’s no way that Trash would ever reconcile with my Father… Oh? For some reason, I’m reminded of a scene where you were having a serious discussion with my Father. How did that reconciliation come about, exactly? I can vaguely recall it, but I think it must have completely shattered your pride. I’m sure they stripped him of all his self-respect and forced him to swear allegiance to Father.
“I think it’s a difficult proposal, but I don’t think it’s impossible. My mother asked me to come here to mediate between His Holiness and Father.”
“I see. I understand your proposal, but… I don’t think the King will listen to it. Don’t you think your mother needs to do something about it first?”
“Well, that—”
“You! Are you saying you can’t grant Lady Melty’s request?!”

For some reason, a knight interrupted the conversation and drew the sword from its sheath at his waist. There’s an ominous vibe in the air. I hurriedly got out of the carriage and tensed my muscles, ready to act at a moment’s notice. But Father stepped in to stop him.
“We’re in the middle of discussing whether to listen or not. The conversation isn’t over yet, so would you please be quiet?”

The Father glared at the knight with a huff, but the knight acted as if he hadn’t a care in the world and assumed a combat stance. Then, a knight standing behind him raised what looked like a projection crystal. This is… could it be that we’re being completely set up? I think it’s a bit too soon, but there’s no doubt about it.
“Stop it! We’re here to reconcile with His Holiness—”
Just as my fiancée tried to warn them, the knights smiled and swung their swords down at her. They were clearly aiming to kill her. But…
“AAAAAAAAAAAH!”
“Air Strike Shield!”

My father instinctively reached forward and cast the Skills. The knights’ swords struck the shield that appeared with a clang and were deflected, so the blades never reached my Finacée. Since he’d known in advance that my Finacée would be suspected of kidnapping, Father seemed to be more wary of the knights than of her.

I didn’t miss that opening and swung my spear at the knight who had been thrown off balance. However, Father’s shield was in the way, so he managed to dodge it. I probably should have used Skills, but my Father and my Finacée were simply too close together.

So I cast a detection Magic spell to see if there were any hidden enemies lurking nearby. It seems there were no hidden figures in the shadows. My Father positioned his shield in front of my Finacée to protect her.
“…What do you think you’re doing?!”
The knight who had luckily dodged my attack—along with the guys behind him—declared in a blatantly condescending tone, with a look that clearly showed they were taking me for granted.
“You wretch, you shield! To take the princess hostage!”
“Huh?”
“Hey, bro, what are those guys talking about? I don’t get it at all…”
“…Are they off on the timing? I see. So this is how they treat me like a criminal…”

My father, who had been glaring at the knights, now wore an exasperated expression. Keel was tilting his head in confusion. I felt the same way. After trying to hurt my own Finacée themselves, what on earth are these guys even talking about?
“There’s no need for Melromarc and the Demon of the Shield to reconcile. The traitorous princess will be the sacrifice to make that happen!”
